text:
Sam Patel: Quick SOC2/ISO sync — I updated the milestone tracker this morning. High level: auditlog-ingest (staging) moved to 2024-10-10, KMS/HSM PoC target 2024-10-25. PTAL and confirm owners/blockers.

Priya Menon: @Sam thanks — who is the owner for the staging ingest pipeline? I have a downstream dependency on the export schema.

Noah Kim: I own the ingest pipeline (eng-infra). PR for export schema merged but needs one more perf run. ETA for perf test: 2024-09-28.

Lara Chen: I own evidence collection & mapping to control IDs. Need a decision on retention policy (90 vs 180 days) and whether S3 buckets must use customer-managed KMS or our managed key. That affects the evidence export flow.

Ben Ortiz: For the HSM attestation/cert chain — legal asked for the vendor certs + API attestation response. Vendor call scheduled 2024-09-26. Can someone paste the attestation call we use?

Noah Kim: quick example (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://vendor-hsm.example.com/api/v1/attest \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -d '{"key_id":"proj-kms-main"}'
```
We also store the JSON response in the auditlog S3 prefix under `evidence/hsm/`.

compliance-bot: Reminder — fieldwork prep checkpoint in 2 weeks. Run `./scripts/export_evidence --controls=all` and upload to https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-evidence.

Priya Menon: Action items summarized:
- Priya: finish export mapping & sample evidence upload (due 2024-10-02)
- Noah: run perf test + confirm staging ingest SLA (due 2024-09-28)
- Lara: make retention + KMS ownership decision (due 2024-09-30)
- Ben: vendor certs & attestation artifact (due 2024-10-01)

Sam Patel: Thanks — I'll update the roadmap and tag these owners in the GH project board. If anyone needs the SOC2 checklist doc link, ping me and I'll drop it here. :thumbsup:

Lara Chen: One more note — if we choose customer-managed KMS, Private deployment teams need an onboarding checklist. I'll start a short doc and share a link when ready.

Noah Kim: noted. I'll include a quick validation step in the perf test to assert `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header is present for all evidence uploads.

Ben Ortiz: adding vendor deliverables to the ticket. cc @legal for certificate acceptance criteria.

Sam Patel: Great progress. Closing the loop: I'll update milestone dates + action owners by EOD and set a short async check-in next Friday.
